say:0:1223301001:0.text: New fish stall in town! Come and take a look!

say:1:1223301002:0.text: The Water Wights' fish stall has opened. Let's check it out.
say:1:1223301002:0.source_cn: 水鬼帮的鱼铺开业了，我们去看看吧！

say:1:1223302001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you came at the perfect time!
say:1:1223302001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you came at the perfect time!
say:1:1223302001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you came at the perfect time!

say:2:1223302002:0.text: What do you think? Our stall looks pretty fine, right?
say:2:1223302002:0.source_cn: 怎么样？这是我们的鱼铺，还不赖吧？
say:2:1223302002:0.male: What do you think? Our stall looks pretty fine, right?
say:2:1223302002:0.female: What do you think? Our stall looks pretty fine, right?

choice_prompt:3:1223302002.text: What do you think? Our stall looks pretty fine, right?
choice_prompt:3:1223302002.source_cn: 怎么样？这是我们的鱼铺，还不赖吧？
choice_prompt:3:1223302002.male: What do you think? Our stall looks pretty fine, right?
choice_prompt:3:1223302002.female: What do you think? Our stall looks pretty fine, right?

say:4:1223302003:0.text: You bet! Everyone's very motivated and excited about running this stall!
say:4:1223302003:0.source_cn: 哈，那当然！兄弟们听说要卖鱼了，干劲足得很！
say:4:1223302003:0.male: You bet! Everyone's very motivated and excited about running this stall!
say:4:1223302003:0.female: You bet! Everyone's very motivated and excited about running this stall!

say:5:1223302004:0.text: Nobody wanted to rent us a stall, and honestly, even if they did, we couldn't afford it either.
say:5:1223302004:0.source_cn: 根本没人愿意出租摊位给我们，不过实话说，就算他们愿意，...
say:5:1223302004:0.male: Nobody wanted to rent us a stall, and honestly, even if they did, we couldn't afford it either.
say:5:1223302004:0.female: Nobody wanted to rent us a stall, and honestly, even if they did, we couldn't afford it either.

say:6:1223302005:1.text: But that didn't stop us! Since we couldn't rent a stall, we just built our own!
say:6:1223302005:1.source_cn: 不过没有啥能难倒我们，没人租给我们，就搭一个！
say:6:1223302005:1.male: But that didn't stop us! Since we couldn't rent a stall, we just built our own!
say:6:1223302005:1.female: But that didn't stop us! Since we couldn't rent a stall, we just built our own!

say:8:1223302006:0.text: That's the spirit! Do it one step at a time!

say:11:1223302007:1.text: A-Al! Something's gone wrong on Thoreau's side!
say:11:1223302007:1.source_cn: 阿、阿尔！出乱子了！梭罗那边！

say:12:1223302008:1.text: What could possibly have gone wrong already?!

say:14:1223302009:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't leave now since the stall has just opened. Could you make a trip there...?
say:14:1223302009:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't leave now since the stall has just opened. Could you make a trip there...?
say:14:1223302009:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't leave now since the stall has just opened. Could you make a trip there...?

choice_prompt:15:1223302009.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't leave now since the stall has just opened. Could you make a trip there...?
choice_prompt:15:1223302009.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，鱼铺刚刚开张，我走不开，能不能请你过去……
choice_prompt:15:1223302009.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't leave now since the stall has just opened. Could you make a trip there...?
choice_prompt:15:1223302009.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't leave now since the stall has just opened. Could you make a trip there...?

say:16:1223302010:0.text: Ha! There's never a shortage of excitement around us. I'm glad you're having fun!
say:16:1223302010:0.source_cn: 哈哈，反正我们身边的热闹从来不少。您喜欢看就好！
say:16:1223302010:0.male: Ha! There's never a shortage of excitement around us. I'm glad you're having fun!
say:16:1223302010:0.female: Ha! There's never a shortage of excitement around us. I'm glad you're having fun!

say:17:1223302011:0.text: I'm counting on you to keep an eye on my good-for-nothing chums. Ha! Get it? Fish stall? Chum? Alright, get outta here!
say:17:1223302011:0.source_cn: 那就拜托您好好看着我那些不成器的兄弟了！
say:17:1223302011:0.male: I'm counting on you to keep an eye on my good-for-nothing chums. Ha! Get it? Fish stall? Chum? Alright, get outta here!
say:17:1223302011:0.female: I'm counting on you to keep an eye on my good-for-nothing chums. Ha! Get it? Fish stall? Chum? Alright, get outta here!

say:1:1223303001:0.text: What should we do now? Al's still waiting for our goods!
say:1:1223303001:0.source_cn: 这可咋办！阿尔还在等我们的货呢！

say:4:1223303003:1.text: Yes, I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> here! Quick, tell us everything!
say:4:1223303003:1.male: Yes, I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> here! Quick, tell us everything!
say:4:1223303003:1.female: Yes, I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> here! Quick, tell us everything!

say:5:1223303004:0.text: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
say:5:1223303004:0.male: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
say:5:1223303004:0.female: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...

choice_prompt:6:1223303004.text: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
choice_prompt:6:1223303004.male: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
choice_prompt:6:1223303004.female: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...

say:7:1223303005:0.text: The robbers were all masked, so I didn't get a clear look at their faces...
say:7:1223303005:0.source_cn: 那群人都蒙着脸，具体什么样没太看清……
say:7:1223303005:0.male: The robbers were all masked, so I didn't get a clear look at their faces...
say:7:1223303005:0.female: The robbers were all masked, so I didn't get a clear look at their faces...

say:8:1223303006:0.text: If I didn't have to mind the goods, I'd have easily taken them all down!
say:8:1223303006:0.source_cn: 要不是我总想护着货，来多少个都给他打趴下！
say:8:1223303006:0.male: If I didn't have to mind the goods, I'd have easily taken them all down!
say:8:1223303006:0.female: If I didn't have to mind the goods, I'd have easily taken them all down!

say:11:1223303007:1.text: Which way did they go? Can we still catch up?

say:12:1223303008:1.text: They're too far away now. *Sigh* It's all my fault!
say:12:1223303008:1.source_cn: 现在也追不上了，唉，都怪我！

say:13:1223303009:1.text: Don't be too hard on yourself! If you can recall any distinctive features of the robbers, you can alert the Carmine Whispers. They'll bring the culprits to justice.
say:13:1223303009:1.source_cn: 别怪自己了，你们再想想那些人有什么特征，回去找血薇帮说...

say:15:1223303010:0.text: That's right! Once we have enough clues, we might have a chance to get your stolen goods back!
say:15:1223303010:0.source_cn: 没错！捋顺出线索，说不定能将那批货追回来！

say:16:1223303011:1.text: To ask for help from those posy parrots? I'd rather—
say:16:1223303011:1.source_cn: 要求助那帮粉毛鹦鹉，那老子宁愿——

say:20:1223303012:0.text: *Cough* <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s helped us a lot. You've got to watch your language in his presence.
say:20:1223303012:0.male: *Cough* <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s helped us a lot. You've got to watch your language in his presence.
say:20:1223303012:0.female: *Cough* <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s helped us a lot. You've got to watch your language in her presence.

say:21:1223303013:1.text: Uh... Anyway, I'll never ask the Carmine Whispers for help!
say:21:1223303013:1.source_cn: 呃……总之，老子绝对不找血薇帮的求助！

say:22:1223303014:1.text: Let's head back and find Al. He must be swamped with the fish stall opening.
say:22:1223303014:1.source_cn: 先回去找阿尔吧，鱼铺要开张，他一个人肯定忙不过来。

say:2:1223305001:1.text: You all look a bit down, guys.

say:3:1223305002:1.text: Our goods got stolen, and the culprits were masked.

say:4:1223305003:1.text: It's all my fault for dozing off...
say:4:1223305003:1.source_cn: 都怪我，要不是我打瞌睡……

say:5:1223305004:1.text: Hey, consider what we've been through, it ain't the end of the world.
say:5:1223305004:1.source_cn: 行吧，比起这些天咱们遇到的，也不算什么大事了。

say:6:1223305005:1.text: Cheer up, fellas. Let's fill our stall with our spare stock and not dwell on the loss.
say:6:1223305005:1.source_cn: 大家，用备用的货把摊位收拾下，其他的别多想了

say:7:1223305006:1.text: Al, shouldn't we try to get the stolen goods back?
say:7:1223305006:1.source_cn: 阿尔，不想办法把货追回来吗？

say:8:1223305007:1.text: We don't have time for that—we have a business to run.
say:8:1223305007:1.source_cn: 咱们还要做生意，哪有那么多闲工夫。

say:9:1223305008:1.text: This isn't our style! We Water Wights never let those who cross us get away!
say:9:1223305008:1.source_cn: 这可不像咱们的作风！水鬼向来睚眦必报！

say:10:1223305009:1.text: How do we get back at them? Do you know who they are?

say:12:1223305011:1.text: Just let it go and focus on what's at hand!
say:12:1223305011:1.source_cn: 这件事过去了就算了，眼前的事更要紧！

say:13:1223305012:0.text: Come on, guys! Get the fish out and arrange them nicely!
say:13:1223305012:0.source_cn: 来，大家搭把手，先把鱼找出来摆好！

say:14:1223305013:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you like to give us a hand?
say:14:1223305013:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you like to give us a hand?
say:14:1223305013:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you like to give us a hand?

say:2:1223309001:0.text: Is that you, Aron? I must say, you're pretty slick. You planted that fly there, didn't you?
say:2:1223309001:0.source_cn: 是阿隆啊？小动作还挺熟练，苍蝇是你粘的吧。

say:3:1223309002:0.text: Say no more! I could have put you out of business from day one if it weren't for your helpers!
say:3:1223309002:0.source_cn: 少废话！要不是你们有帮手，今天让你们从开业变破产！

say:4:1223309003:0.text: ...Renata sent you here, right? Did you steal our goods too?
say:4:1223309003:0.source_cn: ……是雷纳塔让你们来的吧。货也是你们劫的？

say:5:1223309004:0.text: Hmph, I'd have kicked you spineless sea slugs out of Rustport already if it wasn't for these meddling hamsters and their magister!
say:5:1223309004:0.source_cn: 嘁，要不是这碍事的魔法师，今天我要你们这帮软皮蛇消失在...
say:5:1223309004:0.male: Hmph, I'd have kicked you spineless sea slugs out of Rustport already if it wasn't for these meddling hamsters and their magister!
say:5:1223309004:0.female: Hmph, I'd have kicked you spineless sea slugs out of Rustport already if it wasn't for these meddling hamsters and their magister!

say:8:1223309005:1.text: Who are you calling spineless sea slugs?!
say:8:1223309005:1.source_cn: 哈！？原来是你们？你叫谁软皮蛇？！

say:9:1223309006:1.text: Oh? Surprise, surprise. I remember you looked like a scared octopus when we raided your goods! I hope you didn't ink yourself! Ha!
say:9:1223309006:1.source_cn: 喔？劫车时你被吓的跟狗一样，现在吼这么大声？

say:11:1223309008:1.text: We'll be back, sea slugs! Hahaha...
say:11:1223309008:1.source_cn: 我们还会来的！软皮蛇们！哈哈哈……

say:2:1223310002:1.text: Given how things have panned out, I should probably come clean now.
say:2:1223310002:1.source_cn: 事情发展到这个地步，也没什么好隐瞒的。
say:2:1223310002:1.male: Given how things have panned out, I should probably come clean now.
say:2:1223310002:1.female: Given how things have panned out, I should probably come clean now.

say:3:1223310003:1.text: The Water Wights are now divided into two groups—one strives to lead a down-to-earth life, while the other... You've seen what they're like, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:3:1223310003:1.source_cn: 现在水鬼帮分两拨人，一拨想踏踏实实融入锈锚港工作，另一...
say:3:1223310003:1.male: The Water Wights are now divided into two groups—one strives to lead a down-to-earth life, while the other... You've seen what they're like, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:3:1223310003:1.female: The Water Wights are now divided into two groups—one strives to lead a down-to-earth life, while the other... You've seen what they're like, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:5:1223310004:1.text: Hmph! They can't do anything about the Carmine Whispers, so they go after their own people!
say:5:1223310004:1.source_cn: 哼！搞不过血薇帮，来搞自己人！

say:6:1223310005:1.text: *Sigh* The other group is led by Renata, and they were the thugs who stirred up trouble earlier.
say:6:1223310005:1.source_cn: 唉，以雷纳塔为主的其他水鬼帮成员算是一派，就是今天来搞...

say:7:1223310006:1.text: The desire for revenge against the Carmine Whispers unites them.
say:7:1223310006:1.source_cn: 复仇总能让恶棍们更团结，他们还想扳倒血薇帮呢。

say:10:1223310007:1.text: Hmm, I'm not sure if they're out of touch with reality... or simply stupid.
say:10:1223310007:1.source_cn: 唉，该说他们不识时务呢……还是说他们愚蠢呢？

say:13:1223310008:1.text: That Renata is a scheming seasnake! She even messes with her own people! We've got to teach them a lesson!
say:13:1223310008:1.source_cn: 雷纳塔那混蛋！连自己人都搞！我绝对饶不了他们！

say:14:1223310009:1.text: They've long had it in for us, so this fallout was inevitable.
say:14:1223310009:1.source_cn: 他们早就看我们不顺眼了，这场内斗是难免的。

say:17:1223310010:1.text: Everyone now thinks the Water Wights have changed. If there are still troublemakers around, you should report them to the Carmine Whispers.
say:17:1223310010:1.source_cn: 大家都以为水鬼帮沉寂了，如果还有这样的恶党，你们应该报...

say:18:1223310011:1.text: What?! You want us to get help from them?
say:18:1223310011:1.source_cn: 你说什么！你让我们向那群人求助？！

say:19:1223310012:1.text: Not just about seeking help, but also about severing your ties with the other group.
say:19:1223310012:1.source_cn: 当然不是单纯求助，而是跟这些人划清界限。

say:22:1223310013:1.text: The Carmine Whispers might not trust us even if we do report to them.
say:22:1223310013:1.source_cn: 可就算我们去，血薇帮的人也不一定会信任我们。

choice_prompt:25:1223310013.text: The Carmine Whispers might not trust us even if we do report to them.
choice_prompt:25:1223310013.source_cn: 可就算我们去，血薇帮的人也不一定会信任我们。

say:26:1223310014:0.text: Your words carry more weight to them.
say:26:1223310014:0.source_cn: 如果是你的话，他们多少会给个面子吧。<key:dial...
say:26:1223310014:0.male: Your words carry more weight to them.
say:26:1223310014:0.female: Your words carry more weight to them.

say:28:1223310017:0.text: I've decided to visit the Carmine Whispers and clarify things.
say:28:1223310017:0.source_cn: 决定了，还是去找血薇帮的人说清楚，至少要表明我们的态度。

say:29:1223310018:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you go ahead first. I'll clean up the stall and join you shortly.
say:29:1223310018:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you go ahead first. I'll clean up the stall and join you shortly.
say:29:1223310018:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you go ahead first. I'll clean up the stall and join you shortly.

say:31:1223310015:0.text: Your words carry more weight to them.
say:31:1223310015:0.source_cn: 如果是你的话，他们多少会给个面子吧。<key:dial...
say:31:1223310015:0.male: Your words carry more weight to them.
say:31:1223310015:0.female: Your words carry more weight to them.

say:32:1223310016:0.text: You're right—we wouldn't want Renata's evil deeds to implicate us.
say:32:1223310016:0.source_cn: 也对，万一雷纳塔干坏事牵连到我们身上就不好了。
say:32:1223310016:0.male: You're right—we wouldn't want Renata's evil deeds to implicate us.
say:32:1223310016:0.female: You're right—we wouldn't want Renata's evil deeds to implicate us.

choice:25:2:3.text: They know who the enemies are.
choice:25:2:3.source_cn: 他们清楚敌人到底是谁
choice:25:2:3.male: They know who the enemies are.
choice:25:2:3.female: They know who the enemies are.

say:1:1223311002:0.text: Let's go over and chat with him.
say:1:1223311002:0.male: Let's go over and chat with him.
say:1:1223311002:0.female: Let's go over and chat with him.

say:3:1223312001:0.text: Don't give me that look. We've turned over a new leaf. I've got a new job, so I won't steal other people's stuff for now!
say:3:1223312001:0.source_cn: 别瞪老子，老子现在有了新工作，暂时没有打砸抢了！

say:10:1223312004:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you mingling with these people?
say:10:1223312004:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you mingling with these people?
say:10:1223312004:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you mingling with these people?

choice_prompt:11:1223312004.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you mingling with these people?
choice_prompt:11:1223312004.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you mingling with these people?
choice_prompt:11:1223312004.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you mingling with these people?

narration:12:1223312005:0.text: Tell Knox about the ins and outs of the matter...

say:13:1223312006:0.text: What?! A Water Wight called Renata is giving you guys a hard time?
say:13:1223312006:0.source_cn: 什么？！水鬼雷纳塔在骚扰你们？

say:15:1223312007:0.text: Why are you only telling me about this now, Al?
say:15:1223312007:0.source_cn: 为什么现在才交底？阿尔？！

say:17:1223312008:0.text: Hey! You go easy on Al!

say:20:1223312010:0.text: The less trouble, the better for us. After all, our situation is complicated. Who would believe that we're being bullied by our own people?
say:20:1223312010:0.source_cn: 我们这不是怕多一事不如少一事嘛，毕竟我们身份敏感，说我...

say:21:1223312011:0.text: Also, nothing good ever comes out of dealing with you lot. If it wasn't for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we wouldn't come here on our own.
say:21:1223312011:0.source_cn: 每次碰到你们就脱层皮，要不是<style=stress...
say:21:1223312011:0.male: Also, nothing good ever comes out of dealing with you lot. If it wasn't for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we wouldn't come here on our own.
say:21:1223312011:0.female: Also, nothing good ever comes out of dealing with you lot. If it wasn't for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we wouldn't come here on our own.

say:22:1223312012:0.text: I'll report this to Sonja and Lucca.
say:22:1223312012:0.source_cn: 这件事我会上报给索尼娅和卢卡。

say:23:1223312013:0.text: For <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s sake, I'll treat you and the other group as separate entities.
say:23:1223312013:0.male: For <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s sake, I'll treat you and the other group as separate entities.
say:23:1223312013:0.female: For <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s sake, I'll treat you and the other group as separate entities.

say:24:1223312014:0.text: Thanks. We'll keep you in the loop if there are any updates.
say:24:1223312014:0.source_cn: 那就谢了。有新情况我们也会来告诉你们的。

say:25:1223312015:0.text: Just take care of your own problems first. I can never get any peace and quiet with you lot around.
say:25:1223312015:0.source_cn: 管好你们自己吧，真是一群到哪都不省心的家伙。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1223307003:.text: Hey, there's a fly on it!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1223307004:.text: Pay me or I'll report you!
